svg.title: Knovaryn 0.2.1 offline framework benchmark summary
svg.desc: Rates with Wilson 95% confidence intervals: semantic false-accept 0.000 (0/9) CI 0.000–0.299; semantic false-reject 0.000 (0/3) CI 0.000–0.561; preference order-consistency 1.000 (10/10) CI 0.723–1.000. Medians of three deterministic runs: 43.0 ms pipeline wall-clock, 69.78 examples per second, release-bundle SHA-256 identical across runs, 8 of 8 export formats round-trip ok, crash-resume produced no duplicate provider calls. Offline deterministic framework benchmark — not live-model generation throughput. Generated from benchmarks/results/0.2.1/.
